messages:
miriam: heads-up — i'd like to run a slightly different canary / A/B flow for svc-api tonight during the change window (22:00 PST). goal: validate weighted routing + a telemetry guard before full rollout. need 2 approvers.

kevin: can you spell out the traffic splits and timing? also what's the guard threshold?

miriam: plan: initial weighted canary = 5% for 15m, then 25% for 30m, then final cutover if gates pass. guard checks: p95 latency increase > 20% OR error-rate > 1% over the previous baseline -> abort and rollback.

sam: who wires the telemetry -> rollout guard? do we pull from the per-route traces or the rollout-specific metric? need dashboard links for on-call.

miriam: rollout guard reads from /metrics/rollouts/svc-api.* (same as existing rollout runner). i'll add a dashboard tile under Console -> Rollouts -> svc-api/canaries and pin the p95 + 5m error-rate chart. link: https://console/internal/rollouts/svc-api/canaries

cheng: small API ask: can we add a `min_samples` to the guard config so transient low-traffic canaries don't trigger false positives? recommend `min_samples: 200` for this one. also suggest a `stabilization_window: 5m`.

miriam: good call. updated thresholds: min_samples=200, stabilization_window=5m, abort on (p95_inc_pct > 20 OR error_rate_pct > 1) evaluated over 5m.

deploy-bot: NOTICE: deploy request received for svc-api@v3.4.0-canary. Change window: 2026-03-18T22:00:00-08:00. Required approvers: 2 (team leads). Current approvals: 0. To approve, run `/approve 1769954321` or click Approve in Console.

taylor: ack — i'll review logs from the last 24h and approve if infra looks healthy. quick Q: estimated additional QPS on token service from 25% ramp?

kevin: estimate: at 25% split peak extra ~ 120 RPS, token billing delta ~ +$0.06/minute in preprod telemetry; negligible for short windows. we should make sure autoscaler has the burst headroom.

sam: pls add a short-runbook note in the thread for on-call: steps to abort and how to inspect cached prefixes. e.g., `deploy rollback --to previous` and rollout console abort button.

cheng: config snippet i suggest adding to rollout manifest: 

```yaml
rollout:
  mode: canary
  splits: [5, 25]
  windows: ["15m", "30m"]
  guard:
    metrics: ["p95_latency","error_rate"]
    p95_inc_pct_threshold: 20
    error_rate_pct_threshold: 1.0
    min_samples: 200
    stabilization_window: "5m"
    action_on_fail: rollback
```

miriam: this looks good. i'll merge the manifest into ci/cd and tag the deploy. scheduling it for the change window. adding runbook + dashboard tile now.

kevin: approved. (comment: abort on latency spike >300ms too, if we can add as an upper hard limit).

taylor: approved. added a note in the change ticket about quota and autoscale.

deploy-bot: APPROVED: 2/2. Deploy scheduled for 2026-03-18T22:00:00-08:00. If any approver revokes, the deploy will be canceled. To revoke: `/revoke 1769954321`.

sam: thanks — i'll monitor dashboards during the window and post quick summaries here. please ping me if you want manual abort. :eyes: 

miriam: thanks everyone, will follow up after the canary completes with metrics and next steps.
